انتهى"},{"verses":["94:6"],"words":["يُسْرًۭا"],"type":"grammar","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"Context can also make a repeated indefinite refer to the same thing, as in these Qurʾānic examples and in verbal emphasis.","anchor":"وهو الذي في السماء إله وفي الأرض إله","mentions":["43:84","6:37","30:54"]},{"verses":["94:6"],"words":["ٱلْعُسْرِ","يُسْرًۭا"],"type":"grammar","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"A first indefinite can be followed by a definite that has a different, more specific referent, as in the cited examples of scripture, reconciliation, and added punishment.","anchor":"وقد تعاد النكرة معرفة مع المغايرة كقوله تعالى :","mentions":["6:156","4:128","16:88"]},{"verses":["94:6"],"words":["ٱلْعُسْرِ","يُسْرًۭا"],"type":"grammar","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"Repeated definite expressions can also differ in reference: the cited examples distinguish scriptures, kinds of sovereignty, reward, and killer from victim.","anchor":"وقد تعاد المعرفة معرفة مع المغايرة كقوله تعالى :","mentions":["5:48","3:26","55:60","5:45"]},{"verses":["94:6"],"words":["ٱلْعُسْرِ","يُسْرًۭا"],"type":"grammar","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"Conversely, a definite may be repeated as an indefinite without changing its referent, as in the declaration that God is one deity.","anchor":"وقد تعاد المعرفة نكرة مع عدم المغايرة كقوله تعالى :","mentions":["18:110"]},{"verses":["94:6"],"words":["ٱلْعُسْرِ","يُسْرًۭا"],"type":"grammar","speaker":"author","stance":"prefers","claim":"Biqāʿī treats identity for repeated definites and difference for repeated indefinites as defaults that hold absent contextual clues, then applies this to the verse’s definite hardship and indefinite ease.","anchor":"أي العسر الذي أنتم عليه أو الجنس أي الذي يعرفه كل أحد"}]}
